mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prj.prj WHERE prj_id=#{projectId})

SELECT d.dev_nm AS name FROM prj.prj p JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=p.pm_dev_id WHERE p.prj_id=#{projectId} UNION SELECT d.dev_nm AS name FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} AND p.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD') ORDER BY name
